system.description:
HEALER HEALING SOUL UTILITY
Healer Specialist Spell
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet
Targets 1 willing creature

You reinforce the connection between body, mind and animating soul.
Choose one effect:
Restore the Soul: Reduce the target's Soul Drain by 5.
Reassert the Self: Attempt to Counteract one possession effect or magical effect forcibly displacing or controlling the target's soul.

Warping Options:
+4 PP: Apply both effects.
+4 PP: Increase Soul Drain removed by an additional 5.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
